answers.question_text: What is your role in aviation?
What kind of flying do you mainly do?
What are you trying to achieve?
How many days per week can you train?
How much time do you have per session at home?

What equipment do you have at home?

Any current injuries, or things to avoid?
Any movement patterns to avoid entirely?
Alongside the marathon, are there any other goals you'd like to work on? (Pick up to 3, or skip if marathon is your sole focus)
When is your target marathon, Pietro?
What's your current running base like, Pietro? Have you been running regularly, or are you building from scratch?
How many hours per week can you realistically commit to marathon training, Pietro?
Do you use any wearables or training tech to track your running, Pietro?
What does a typical training week look like for you right now, Pietro? Are you doing any structured sessions — tempo runs, intervals, long runs — or mostly easy mileage?
Have you run a marathon before, Pietro? If so, what was your time?
